name: browser-error-evidence
goal: Component evidence retains and displays browser error diagnostics with expected, unexpected and missing-error outcomes bound to the tested revision.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Persist exact browser error diagnostics with test and revision identity; show expected, unexpected and missing expected errors in both component viewers; retain inherited origin and retries.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: test/browser-error-evidence.test.ts fails both runner outcomes because browserErrors is dropped; unchanged desktop browser-error-evidence.spec.ts fails missing Browser errors group at 1440 and 390px. Before screenshots inspected in work/browser-error-evidence/before.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Shared fixture persists diagnostics before asserting; verification and history retain them with origin checks; both viewers share BrowserErrors; malformed diagnostics fail collection.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Both original viewers fail the unchanged 1440/390px tests. Restored viewers pass all four cases; 15 desktop evidence regressions pass; 8 collector/persistence tests and 38 nearby unit/integration checks pass. Screenshots inspected.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Root check stages passed after repairing the list-key guard and resuming its failed stage. Root: 817 unit, 228 E2E, 32 packaged tests. Reports: 551 unit; planning: 50; desktop: 827 unit, 174 browser; collaboration: 43; hub: 460 unit, 26 browser; remote: 135; relay: 159. Static checks, audits, unit/scenario registries pass. The unchanged 1440/390px regressions fail the original views and pass both final views; fresh screenshots inspected. Optional Jev review remains incomplete.
